properties.description: The root of the `on_disk` test program: the 19 test files of reflow2-mcp every one of whose tests opens a design store in a folder (a store across a restart, the on-disk format and stamp, the identity file, the lock, a store's import and export, the shared daemon, the real binary on a real design). `required-features = ["rocksdb"]`, so a build without on-disk storage skips it whole and CI's full job runs it.
properties.name: tests/on_disk.rs — the MCP crate's on-disk test program
